# #602 — langfuse-trace: session/repeat reject real API responses — list-endpoint observations are string ids, schema requires objects

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: bug
Created: 2026-08-06T11:57:27Z
Updated: 2026-08-06T12:31:10Z
Closed: 2026-08-06T12:31:10Z

---

Found on the FIRST live run of the merged #601 tooling (controller closure demo). `bun scripts/langfuse-trace.ts repeat search_brain --query ... -n 3` fails with `Langfuse returned an invalid trace-list response` (exit 2).

Root cause, verified against the live instance: `GET /api/public/traces` returns each row's `observations` as an array of STRING observation ids, while `tracePageSchema` (scripts/langfuse-trace.ts:57) validates `observations: z.array(observationSchema)` — full objects. The PR's stub server and fixtures modeled the detail-endpoint shape on list rows, so every test passed while every real list call fails. `get`/`diff` are unaffected (the detail endpoint does return objects — live-verified during the #601 swarm).

Fix shape: list-row schema accepts observation ids (`z.union([observationSchema, z.string()])` inside the array, or drop `observations` from list rows entirely since the list path never reads them); fixture updated to the REAL list shape; regression test parsing a captured real list response; live smoke of `session` and `repeat` in the PR receipt.

Lesson for the record (extends the #601 SME entry): validating against a hand-written stub proves conformance to the stub, not to the API — a captured real response belongs in the fixtures.

Part of the #569 wave (tooling follow-up); found before #569 closure, so #569 stays open until this is fixed and the live repeat demo passes.
